jobs.occupation: Packing & Fulfilment Coordinator
jobs.description:
Packing & Fulfilment Coordinator — MK STUDIO, Glostrup

Hourly paid · 150 DKK/hour · Minimum 32 h/week guaranteed, Mon–Fri · Up to 40 h/week in busy periods · Start October–November 2026

MK STUDIO (mk-ceramics ApS) makes handmade porcelain cups, plates, bowls and coffee drippers in Glostrup. We're a team of seven across the workshop, office and our Copenhagen shop, selling to cafés, roasters and coffee people across Denmark, the EU and Asia.

In a strong week we make 500–1000 cups. We're looking for the person who gets every order out the door correctly and makes sure nothing leaves the studio with a defect.

What you'll do

Orders and customers (about half your week)

• 
Pack 10–15 webshop orders a day, plus wholesale (B2B) orders

• 
Book shipments and print labels in the DHL and UPS apps

• 
Prepare invoices, packing lists and customs documents for shipments outside the EU

• 
Answer all order and customer emails: order status, delays, returns, breakage claims

• 
Handle claims with carriers for damaged or lost parcels

• 
Keep packing materials in stock

Studio and stock (about half your week)

• 
Unload kilns after the glaze firing

• 
Check every piece and sort it: first quality, seconds, reject

• 
Finishing work on fired pieces

• 
Organise the stock room and keep stock numbers correct in our order system

You're the last check before a piece reaches a customer.

What you need

• 
Fluent written and spoken English — you'll talk and write to customers every day

• 
Right to work in Denmark

• 
You can lift and carry up to 20 kg (kiln shelves, boxes) and work on your feet most of the day in a studio with clay dust

• 
Available Monday to Friday, at least 32 hours a week, with extra hours in busy periods, from October–November 2026

• 
Experience with order handling, shipping, warehouse, e-commerce, customer service or similar work

• 
You plan your own day, handle several tasks at once, and flag mistakes early

Good to have

• 
Danish

• 
Driving licence

• 
DHL/UPS bookings and claims

• 
Customs or export paperwork

• 
Experience packing fragile goods (glass, ceramics, wine)

• 
e-conomic, Shopify or spreadsheets

• 
Ceramics or quality-control experience

What we offer

• 
150 DKK/hour, plus holiday pay

• 
32 guaranteed hours a week

• 
3-month trial period

• 
After 6 months, we sit down and negotiate your pay based on your performance and any extra tasks you've taken on

• 
A small team with short lines and fast decisions

• 
Full training in our systems and quality standards

How to apply

Apply through the form at www.mk-ceramics.com/pages/mk-studio-work-with-us (select "Packing").

Write a short message telling us why you'd like to work with us and why you think you're a good fit for this job. Then answer these five questions with yes or no, based on this job ad:

• 
Is this job paid by the hour?

• 
Is the guaranteed minimum 40 hours a week?

• 
Is about half of the job packing orders and answering customer emails?

• 
Do you need to work weekends in this job?

• 
Does the job start in January 2027?

We'll reply by email and ask for your CV.

jobs.occupation: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description: Operations and techniciansTeamlead Reliability EngineersImagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Vi kombinerer klassiske amerikanske slice-opskrifter med gode råvarer, koldhævet dej og bagning ved høj varme. Location: Copenhagen (Blågårds Plads / Tagensvej)Employment Type: Full-time / Part-time (Evenings and weekends)Pay: 175 – 185 DKK / hour (based on experience)Start Date: As soon as possible

About Diamond Slice

Diamond Slice serves New York-style sourdough pizza by the slice in Copenhagen from our locations at Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej. We combine traditional American slice shop recipes with quality ingredients, cold-fermented dough, and high-heat deck ovens. We run busy counter, dine-in, and delivery services, and we are actively building for future growth.

The Role

As Kitchen Manager, you are responsible for the day-to-day operations of the kitchen. You make sure food quality is consistent across all orders, keep kitchen systems clean and compliant, and guide the kitchen team in close coordination with our front of house (FOH) staff.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Daily kitchen operations, including prep, baking, and ongoing quality control

• 
Ordering goods, receiving deliveries, and inventory management

• 
Directing, training, and supervising kitchen staff on shift

• 
Maintaining strict kitchen cleanliness, hygiene routines, and Danish food safety standards

• 
Serving as the main kitchen contact point for FOH during service

• 
Managing rush periods and high-volume delivery tickets calmly and efficiently

Requirements

• 
Minimum 3 years of experience in the hospitality industry

• 
Experience with pizza OR experience with management is required (experience managing a pizza kitchen is a strong advantage)

• 
Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills

• 
Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours

• 
Comfortable working full shifts on your feet

• 
Ready and available to work evening and weekend shifts

• 
Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus)

What We Offer

• 
Hourly wage of 175 – 185 DKK/hour based on experience

• 
Training and technical skills in producing world-class New York-style pizza

• 
A hardworking but friendly and supportive atmosphere

• 
A growing company with opportunities to take on more responsibility and higher pay over time

• 
A flexible schedule

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter to:Email: work@diamondslice.dkSubject line: Kitchen ManagerApplications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

About Rays Chicken

At Rays Chicken, we take fried chicken seriously. We make extra-crispy, buttermilk-brined fried chicken seasoned with our proprietary secret spice mix, serving the vibrant, packed crowd at the popular neighborhood spot Gamma Bar in Copenhagen Nordvest.

We are currently laying the groundwork for exciting future growth, and we are looking for a dedicated chef who wants to be an integral part of that journey.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and dependable kitchen professional who can take charge of daily kitchen operations, maintain high standards of quality, and keep a cool head during busy periods.

On slower early-week shifts, you will have full autonomy to prep and run the kitchen independently. On busier nights, you will lead the service and direct kitchen support staff.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Food Prep & Service: Daily mise en place, cooking, frying, plating, and ensuring high food quality.

• 
Independent Shifts: Running kitchen operations solo during early-week shifts.

• 
Team Leadership: Scheduling, guiding, and overseeing kitchen helpers and dishwashers.

• 
Stock & Orders: Managing inventory, placing orders, receiving deliveries, and liaising with daily suppliers.

• 
Hygiene & Safety: Keeping kitchen systems organized and strictly upholding Danish food safety and sanitation standards.

• 
Digital Orders: Operating takeaway and online delivery platforms efficiently.

• 
Menu Input (Bonus): We are actively looking to develop our menu. While not a strict requirement, an interest in recipe testing and creative input is a big plus!

What We Are Looking For:

• 
Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional kitchen experience.

• 
Independence: Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills.

• 
Pace & Mindset: Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours.

• 
Stamina: Comfortable working full shifts on your feet.

• 
Availability: Ready and available to work evenings and weekends.

• 
Communication: Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus).

• 
Passion: A true love for fried chicken and high-quality comfort food.

What We Offer:

• 
Hourly wage between 165 and 185 DKK/hour, commensurate with experience.

• 
A relaxed, community-driven atmosphere at Gamma Bar in creative Nordvest.

• 
Opportunity to shape operational routines and influence future menu offerings as the concept expands.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter telling us why you’d be a great fit for Rays Chicken to:

• 
Email: work@diamondslice.dk

• 
Subject line: Rays Chefs

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you!
